description: Repères de crues [CD45] - Département du Loiret is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Loiret. La couche contient les 22 repères de crues posés par le Département du Loiret sur les bâtiments du CD45 ou en lien avec le CD45 et situés en zone inondable de la Loire. Coverage: Département du Loiret. The publisher named on the listing is Département du Loiret. Its keywords include reperes, crue, risques, reperes-de-crues, risque-inondation, inondation. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
